reproduction: Build packages with pnpm build and generate the Next.js codegen app with bash scripts/codegen/setup-nextjs.sh if absent.
Run pnpm exec next build in codegen-projects/nextjs, then node ../../scripts/codegen/assert-nextjs-auth-boundary.mjs .next.
Start a fresh NODE_ENV=test production Next.js server on an unused port. Restart this in-memory server before every take.
From e2e, run the demo-video skill recorder against product-proof/analytics-funnels-demo.mjs with --mp4 and PRODUCT_PROOF_BASE_URL set to that server.
Copy analytics-funnels.mp4 and shots/*.png from test-results/analytics-funnels-proof into this directory and screenshots/. Visually check each caption against its screenshot.
For after.png, capture the Conversion funnel region after running the configured sequence. For mobile.png, repeat at 390 by 844 and scroll the result summary below the fixed navigation.
regression: e2e/tests/smoke.analytics.spec.ts: analytics funnels report ordered sessions and export the configured steps
